source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check Jumper are follow spec
1. Prepare System spec and M/B .
2.Check Jumper position

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Jumper should match with system spec.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Jumper check: jumper audit (all jumpers correct position/setting) is a physical visual inspection; human-only.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator audits and records all jumpers; agent cannot inspect the board.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO. Correctly identifies visual inspection but omits board revision, full jumper inventory and no-change safeguards.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED. V2 adds board-specific map, per-jumper evidence, ESD/power controls and forbids corrective movement.

original_test_intent: Audit every physical motherboard jumper against the approved position for the exact board/system specification without altering the configuration.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies the motherboard revision, follows the complete jumper map, visually inspects each reference and pin position under safe access, photographs it and records expected-versus-observed status without moving hardware.
manual_activity: The core acceptance is visual verification of every physical jumper position and pin orientation. Software identity or status cannot establish those physical facts.
required_inputs: Complete jumper reference/pin/default or approved position table
Powered-off/discharged chassis access and ESD procedure
Lighting/magnification/photo policy, operator and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Use the approved power state and ESD controls; do not touch or bridge pins during inspection.
Stop on a board-revision mismatch, ambiguous numbering, damaged/missing jumper or unsafe access.
Record mismatches without correcting them under this audit.
Preserve physical and platform baselines; no automatic follow-on action.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only board identity and BMC/BIOS/host health supporting evidence.
Prepare and completeness-check the per-jumper comparison matrix and photo index.
Do not infer a physical position, authorize correction or issue the verdict.
engineer_actions: Supply and approve the exact jumper specification.
Perform and record every visual inspection.
Disposition mismatches separately and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its no-command physical conclusion is applicable but lacks audit completeness and board identity controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain physical visual inspection; use read-only platform identity only as corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: System-spec comparison, motherboard scope and 5/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN VISUAL AUDIT WITH TRACEABLE JUMPER MATRIX
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a revision-controlled board diagram and one timestamped photo/observation per jumper showing reference, pin numbering, observed position and expected position.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board assembly/revision and specification revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner motherboard jumper map and system configuration specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds completeness, identity and immutable evidence without moving hardware.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; all jumpers remain in scope.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Board revision, full map and safe inspection conditions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Photos with obscured silkscreen or perspective can misidentify pins, requiring direct operator verification.

project_override_considerations: A project may scope a documented subset only through an approved coverage override and must not report omitted jumpers as audited. Any correction is a separate authorized procedure.
expected_evidence: Board/spec revisions, complete jumper inventory and authorization
Per-jumper reference, expected/observed pins and timestamped physical photo/observation
Restored chassis state, supporting platform health and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently require comparison with the system specification; absent map and board revision are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The specification can be supplied and a qualified operator can inspect the board; physical/manual does not equal blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with NO and add full board-specific evidence and no-change boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and its inspection controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps agent completeness checking separate from physical proof and engineer judgment.

review_improvement: Turns an unspecified visual check into an exhaustive, revision-specific, non-mutating audit with per-jumper provenance.
independent_technical_reasoning: The tested property is a physical shunt position relative to silkscreened pins. No remote register is guaranteed to represent every jumper, so visual operator evidence is indispensable and the case is MANUAL ONLY.
